testResults.name: focused-activation-adapter-tests
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/thesis/integrations/
testResults.result: 25 tests (16 new): the same request contract is asserted byte-identical for local process and remote API boundaries; capability gating blocks live/shadow by default before any invocation; status/manifests/artifacts/portfolio/risk map real harness API payload shapes (POST /v1/backtests/jobs 202+Location, GET runs/{id}, artifacts); records are proven inert data (no behavior, frozen); unavailable surfaces (404/501) map to StatusSurface.unavailable rather than fabricated data

testResults.name: wave-integration-suite
testResults.result: 2368 passed, 14 skipped, 1 xfailed at wave edit freeze

testResults.name: lint-and-type-gates
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev ruff check src/thesis/integrations tests/thesis/integrations && uv run --extra dev ty check src/thesis/integrations
testResults.result: ruff and ty clean on the integrations package

limitations: Portfolio and risk-decision remote routes (/v1/runtime/*) are prospective and map to StatusSurface.unavailable until the harness publishes them
